description: Compose a transaction to send Counterparty tokens to an address

inputs_set.description: Comma-separated UTXOs to use as inputs (txid:vout)

no_dispense.description: If true, prevent this send from triggering a dispenser on the destination address

quantity.description: Raw integer amount. For divisible assets: multiply human amount by 10^8 (e.g. 1.0 XCP = 100000000). For indivisible: use whole number. Check get_asset_info for divisibility.

sat_per_vbyte.description: Fee rate in satoshis per virtual byte (e.g. 1, 5.5, 0.15). Check get_fee_estimate for current market rates.

name: compose_send
